title: Implement wave-shapers oversampling and air EQ
description:
Implement Source/DSP/AuralExciter.cpp only, matching Source/DSP/AuralExciter.h from c.1.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY Source/DSP/AuralExciter.cpp.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/AuralExciter.h (API, members, modes — implement exactly)
- Other Source/DSP/*.cpp for prepare/process, ScopedNoDenormals, smoothing, buffer handling patterns
- JUCE Oversampling usage patterns already in the tree if any

Implementation requirements (real-time safe):
- prepareToPlay/prepare: construct/configure juce::dsp::Oversampling<float> (2x/4x polyphase FIR selectable), query latency, size any pre-allocated buffers; never construct oversampler in process()
- High-pass sidechain: 2nd-order juce::dsp SVF, cutoff EXC_TUNE clamped to [800 Hz, 10 kHz]
- Non-linear stage on high-passed signal inside oversampled domain, modes:
  1) Cubic Soft Clipping with piecewise 2/3 and 4/3 thresholds
  2) Asymmetric Tube: y = tanh(G*x + delta) + gamma*(G*x)^2 with delta ≈ 0.15 (even harmonics), gamma from EXC_HARMONICS
  3) Tape: y = (2/pi)*arctan(G*x)
- Post-saturation high-shelf Air EQ above 10 kHz from EXC_AIR_GAIN
- Smooth drive gain G, delta, and gamma off the raw per-sample parameter path (no zipper noise)
- process(): juce::ScopedNoDenormals; no heap allocation, no locks, no filesystem/UI
- Dry/wet or blend policy only if already declared in the header; do not invent new public API beyond the header

Verification intent for this task: compile Standalone only after this file exists:
cmake -B cmake-build-debug -G Ninja && cmake --build cmake-build-debug --target AuralMaximizerPro_Standalone
plus cppcheck on Source/DSP and clang-format on the cpp file when run by the executor.

Do not edit the header, processor, editor, or docs.
acceptance_criteria: Source/DSP/AuralExciter.cpp exists and implements the API declared in Source/DSP/AuralExciter.h
AuralExciter prepares Oversampling and SVF in prepare, not in process
Wave-shapers implement Cubic Soft Clip, Asymmetric Tube, and Tape as specified
Air EQ high-shelf above 10 kHz is driven by EXC_AIR_GAIN
Drive G, delta, and gamma use smoothed values in the audio path
cppcheck --enable=all Source/DSP passes or reports no errors in AuralExciter.cpp
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: heap allocate or lock in process()
use make as the build command

allowed: implement wave-shaper math and oversampled process path per header
use juce::SmoothedValue or project-equivalent smoothers for G/delta/gamma
forbidden: introduce FFT libraries or non-JUCE DSP frameworks
full multi-format plugin build targets in this task
